How much is a used Xbox Series X worth?

The Xbox Series X is a steady seller, but it is easy to mix up with the cheaper Series S. Here is what decides the price.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The Series X is a tall black box with a disc drive (1 TB). Since 2024 there is also an all-digital white version and a 2 TB edition. The Xbox Series S is much smaller, mostly white, has no disc drive and sells for considerably less.

What decides the price

  • Version: disc, digital or 2 TB edition.
  • Controller: included, working, no drift.
  • Condition: scratches, dust in the vents, fan noise.
  • Completeness: power cable, HDMI cable, box.

Check before you buy

  • Confirm it is a Series X, not a Series S.
  • Start a game and listen to the fan.
  • Test the disc drive with a disc.
  • The seller should remove their Microsoft account and reset the console.

Where it sells best

Heavy and bulky, so local pickup or a well-packed parcel. Sells on eBay and local marketplaces; Vinted works too for buyers nearby.

Today's price

Prices for a used Xbox Series X change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Xbox Series X worth?

It depends on version, storage, controller and condition. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Microsoft Xbox Series X" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Is an Xbox Series S worth as much as a Series X?

No. The Series S is a smaller, cheaper console and resells for clearly less.

Does Game Pass affect the resale value?

No. Subscriptions are tied to the account, not the console. Make sure the seller has removed their account.
